en_title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Comes Close to Passing Avengers: Endgame With Second Biggest Box Office Debut of All Time at $927 Million Globally
cn_title: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》全球开画影史第二
subtitle: 险胜与惜败
opus_summary: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》全球开画9.27亿美元(约合人民币63亿元)，创索尼和蜘蛛侠开画纪录，影史第二。北美仅落后《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》200万美元(约合人民币1352万元)，排名待定。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day combined the power of Tom Holland and the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) to bring in an estimated $927 million at the global box office during its opening weekend in theaters.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》集结汤姆·赫兰德与漫威电影宇宙（MCU）的号召力，在上映首周末预计斩获9.27亿美元(约合人民币63亿元)全球票房。

paragraphs.en: It's a figure that firmly places the Destin Daniel Cretton-directed superhero movie toward the top of even high-end expectations going into its July 31 premiere. Although these estimations still fell short of records broken by Marvel's Avengers: Endgame in 2019, Spider-Man: Brand New Day will comfortably swing away from its debut with the biggest opening of the year so far.
paragraphs.cn: 这一成绩让德斯汀·丹尼尔·克雷顿执导的超级英雄电影，在7月31日首映前即使按最高预期衡量也名列前茅。尽管这些预估仍未达到漫威2019年《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》创下的纪录，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》仍将以今年迄今最高开画成绩轻松起步。

paragraphs.en: Let's break down the numbers. Domestically, the MCU Spidey flick brought in an estimated $355 million from its 4,487 theaters, with its international total sitting at $572 million. The broken records that come with that include the biggest opening ever for a Sony or Spider-Man movie, but it does still fall short of what Endgame was able to bring in .
paragraphs.cn: 具体来看，这部MCU蜘蛛侠电影在北美4,487家影院预计取得3.55亿美元(约合人民币24亿元)，国际票房则为5.72亿美元(约合人民币39亿元)。这些成绩带来了索尼电影和蜘蛛侠电影的史上最高开画纪录，但仍不及《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》的表现。

paragraphs.en: The MCU team-up film opened to $357.1 million domestically – a painful $2 million more than Spider-Man: Brand New Day – and an unbelievable $1.2 billion globally. Although Holland, who appears in both films, comes out a winner either way, the new Spider-Man movie does still come in second on both accounts – but there is a catch.
paragraphs.cn: 这部MCU集结电影北美开画为3.571亿美元(约合人民币24亿元)，只比《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》令人扼腕地多出200万美元(约合人民币1352万元)；全球开画更高达1.2十亿美元(约合人民币81亿元)。汤姆·赫兰德两部片都有出演，无论结果如何都是赢家，但新《蜘蛛侠》在两项成绩上目前确实都排第二——不过还有个变数。

paragraphs.en: The box office calculations we're seeing today are the estimates for the weekend as final totals for Sunday are tallied. Although Endgame’s spot globally seems secure, the domestic race is brutally close. A small bump could potentially see Spidey take the domestic crown as the count is ironed out in the coming days. Regardless, it won't be all second-place victories for Spider-Man, as the film still managed to eke out wins with the biggest preview sales of all time , and the biggest opening day sales of all time .
paragraphs.cn: 我们今天看到的票房数据，是在核算周日最终总额期间得出的周末预估。尽管《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》的全球排名看来稳固，北美之争却异常胶着。接下来几天随着统计敲定，些许上调就可能让蜘蛛侠夺得北美桂冠。无论如何，《蜘蛛侠》并非所有项目都是第二：本片仍以微弱优势拿下影史最高预售票房和影史最高首日票房。

paragraphs.en: At just shy of $1 billion at the global box office, Spider-Man: Brand New Day could very well be the biggest earner of the year by the time 2026 ends. In this case (as well as many others), Marvel is likely its biggest competitor, with Avengers: Doomsday sure to have theaters swarming with moviegoers when its opening weekend arrives this December. Even then, either film could outperform the other when all is said and done as fans line up to catch the biggest reveals Marvel has to offer.
paragraphs.cn: 全球票房已接近10亿美元(约合人民币68亿元)，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》到2026年结束时很可能成为当年票房最高的电影。在这件事上(以及其他许多事情上)，漫威很可能是它最大的竞争对手：当《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》于今年12月迎来首周末时，影院势必涌入观众。即便如此，等一切尘埃落定，两部电影中任一部都可能超越另一部，因为影迷会排队观看漫威将揭晓的最大秘密。

paragraphs.en: No matter how the future shakes out for Spidey, there was only one clear victor during the 2026 July-to-August weekend: movie fans. It was the biggest collective weekend in domestic box office history, reaching $430 million across the films available in theaters (via Variety ).
paragraphs.cn: 无论蜘蛛侠未来表现如何，2026年7月底至8月初这个周末只有一个明确赢家：电影观众。这是北美票房史上所有上映影片合计最高的周末，总额达到4.3亿美元(约合人民币29亿元)(据《综艺》报道)。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day predictably made up the bulk of that number, with The Odyssey coming in second place at $51 million, Toy Story 5 in third with $6.3 million, Minions & Monsters in fourth with $5.8 million, and Disney's live-action Moana in fifth with $5.3 million. As the new animated Pixar film continues to build past the $1 billion milestone it reached last weekend, Christopher Nolan's epic adaptation is inching closer to it. The Odyssey now stands tall with $911.4 million worldwide as it continues to charge through expectations following its impressive debut .
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》占据了其中大头；《奥德赛》以5,100万美元(约合人民币3亿元)位居第二，《玩具总动员5》以630万美元(约合人民币4259万元)列第三，《Minions & Monsters》以580万美元(约合人民币3921万元)列第四，迪士尼真人版《海洋奇缘》以530万美元(约合人民币3583万元)列第五。这部新的皮克斯动画电影在上周突破10亿美元(约合人民币68亿元)后仍在累积票房，克里斯托弗·诺兰的史诗改编作也正逐渐接近这一门槛。《奥德赛》全球票房现为9.114亿美元(约合人民币62亿元)，在亮眼开画后仍持续超出预期。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day stars Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, and more and picks up after the events of Spider-Man: No Way Home saw everyone on Earth lose their memories of Peter Parker. Despite just two movies on the calendar for 2026, the year could end up being one of Marvel Studios' biggest ever. We'll know if the new Spidey flick managed to secure a win over Endgame or get stuck in second in the coming days.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》由汤姆·赫兰德、赞达亚、萨迪·辛克、雅各布·巴塔隆、乔恩·伯恩瑟等主演，承接《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》中全地球人都失去彼得·帕克记忆后的故事。尽管漫威影业2026年档期上仅有两部电影，这一年仍可能成为其史上最成功的年份之一。未来几天我们就会知道，这部新蜘蛛侠电影能否战胜《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》，还是只能停在第二名。

paragraphs.en: Until then, you can check out IGN's 7/10 review for the film. You can also check out what Metal Gear Solid creator Hideo Kojima thought about the movie , and you can learn about the leak the film got hit by on release day.
paragraphs.cn: 在此之前，你可以查看IGN为本片给出的7/10评测，也可以看看《潜龙谍影》创作者小岛秀夫对这部电影的看法，并了解影片在上映日遭遇的泄露事件。
